label: Inherited West African feminist critique of Western epistemic stereotyping
description: Echoing Aidoo’s reversal of the Western gaze, Adichie diagnosed "the danger of a single story" as an epistemic harm flattening African lives.
dialecticalTension: Translates West African feminist critique into global public philosophy.
historicalContext: TED Global (2009) & We Should All Be Feminists (2014).

label: Built on Nigerian feminist traditions centering everyday women’s agency
description: Adichie’s public philosophy of gender equality and Igbo cultural memory resonates with Ogundipe’s Nigerian feminist legacy.
dialecticalTension: Carries Nigerian feminist discourse into 21st-century global public sphere.
